mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, COUNT(*) AS message_count, MIN(created_at) AS first_message_at, MAX(created_at) AS last_message_at FROM spring_ai_chat_memory WHERE conversation_id LIKE #{prefix} GROUP BY conversation_id ORDER BY last_message_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT role, content, created_at FROM spring_ai_chat_memory WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
